noncomputable def formula (A : Type*) [SupSet A] [Add A] (s t : Set A) : A :=
  Add.add (sSup s) (sSup t)
theorem real_specialization (s t : Set ℝ) : formula ℝ s t = sSup s + sSup t := rfl
theorem generic_specialization {A : Type*} [SupSet A] [Add A] (s t : Set A) :
    formula A s t = sSup s + sSup t := rfl
theorem empty : formula ℝ ∅ ∅ = 0 := by
  simp only [formula, Real.sSup_empty, add_zero]
theorem unbounded {s t : Set ℝ} (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) (ht : ¬ BddAbove t) :
    formula ℝ s t = 0 := by
  simp only [formula, Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove hs, Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove ht, add_zero]
#check @SupSet.sSup
#check @Add.add
#check @Set.image2
#check @Real.sSup_empty
#check @Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove
#print axioms formula
#print axioms real_specialization
#print axioms generic_specialization
#print axioms empty
#print axioms unbounded
end Lem6Phi183Isolated
